candidates.finding: REFUTED by checkpoint evidence: 277 stored runs span 277 distinct (race, frame_index) states (group size 1 everywhere). Each driver row on a nominal lap maps to a different timeline frame (driver-specific state_time_s). Cross-row simulation reuse would change T and is scientifically invalid.
candidates.inputs: full-field initial_state at exact T, selection, sampler, per-driver mechanisms at T
candidates.item: full-field run_mc2 across driver rows of one (race, lap)

candidates.finding: run_mc2 has no target-driver parameter; outputs are full-field (winner/position distributions for every driver). Per-row extraction of one driver's slice is presentation-only.
D runner already caches params/service/grid per race; _service_for has module cache. Prep ~0.07s/state vs ~19-30s run. No material duplication.
_prepare_state_and_mechanisms re-derives history/slopes per distinct T. Distinct T means distinct history windows; sharing across T would change mechanisms.
candidates.inputs: history window <= T, anchor, slopes, sampler selection

candidates.finding: mc2_stream recomputes sha256(tag)+sha256(dim) per simulation (5000x/run); both are module constants. Micro-duplication.
candidates.item: RNG domain tag derivation per simulation

candidates.finding: rho, regime_std_s, slopes fixed per run, yet validate_rho runs 3x per residual step (16.9M calls) and innovation_scale sqrt recomputed per step. Hoistable without semantic change.
DriverMechanism frozen dataclass rebuilt per residual step (5.7M constructions/run) carrying 6 unchanged fields + previous_eps. Allocation churn, not science.
DynamicsInput dataclass built per event (5.6M); slopes run-fixed, only laps_ahead varies. Drift table per (driver, laps_ahead) is exactly precomputable (bounded ~60 laps).
pool of uniforms bulk-drawn per sim (good), then sample_unit does scalar np.interp per draw (5.6M calls, 3x asarray each). Vectorized quantile over the pool array computes the same values.
candidates.inputs: one pool array per sim; order-preserving consumption
candidates.item: scalar sampler calls over bulk pool

candidates.finding: checkpoint json.dump of the entire accumulated mc2_out every 5 rows (~56 full dumps, final 1.3MB) = O(n^2) serialization. Minor at 277 rows; redesign before parallel writers.
per-step min/sorted/dictcomp over pending dicts (22.4M min calls). Event order is deterministic (time, driver_id tie-break); a heap preserves it exactly with lower constant.

computational_unit: one full-field MC2 run for one exact factual field state (race_id, frame_index/state_time_s) at fixed (arm, seed, simulation_count); per-row extraction is presentation
description: P0 duplicate-work audit. The headline hypothesis (share one simulation across drivers of a lap) is refuted with checkpoint evidence; remaining duplication is within-run overhead.
